threads.body: The comment above this test is written in the present tense (“so this fails while … reads …”), but after this PR the test is expected to pass because `isEnabled()` now reads via the coercing `SpringConfigProvider`. Updating the wording would prevent future confusion when the test passes.

replies.body:
Reworded in 55f1631 — the comment now states what the test guards ("passes only while `isEnabled()` reads the flag through a config provider that coerces") instead of describing the failure it was written against.

_🤖 Addressed by [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)_

threads.body: The PR description still says this auto-configuration is added to both registration files and that `SpringConfigProvider`, `SpringDeclarativeConfigProperties`, and `EmbeddedConfigFile` move to `.internal`. This revision instead discovers the nested configuration through `OpenTelemetryAutoConfiguration` and leaves those helpers in their original package. Please update the description (including its commit/test-name details) so it accurately describes the implementation being reviewed.

replies.body:
Rewrote the description against the current code — the nested `SpanLoggingConfig` discovered through `OpenTelemetryAutoConfiguration`, no registration-file entries, helpers left package-private, and the test table updated to the tests that now exist.
